description: Synthetic: escrow ids, block hashes, block numbers and indexes are made up. Only the genesis hash is real (faucet GET /chain and tclk/flop/VERIFICATION.md). Escrow b2 has a clean finalized open at block 110. A finalized release whose escrow id (0x12) does not parse sits at block 500 on a page for blocks 100 to 199. Out of range does not switch off the unparsable id rule, so b2 is unverified.
